text:
Anya R.: Quick sync — want to run a dress-rehearsal / dry-run for this week's inference benchmark readout. Goal: validate dashboards, confirm artifact locations, and rehearse the rollback/fallback talking points. 30–45m. Who can join? Thu 9:30am PT or Fri 11am PT preferred. Also need someone to own the canary run.

Derek H.: I can own the canary. Thu 9:30 PT works for me.

Maria S.: Friday 11am PT is better for me (travel Thu). Can we ask teams to drop pre-read artifacts by Wed EOD? :pray:

Kevin L.: I’ll prepare the KV-cache heatmap + latency split by bucket and upload to the drive. Will also include a short note on quantization deltas.

Anya R.: Thanks Kevin. Maria — Wed EOD pre-reads is reasonable. I’ll create the invite once we lock slot.

Derek H.: Also add a short smoke test before the dry-run to sanity-check metrics (1k requests, mixed seq lengths). I can schedule it Wed 6pm PT unless someone objects.

Kevin L.: vote: Thu 9:30 PT. If Derek runs the smoke test Wed 6pm, can you post the raw logs to /bench/logs/1823456789 and a one-line summary in the thread?

Maria S.: vote: Fri 11am PT. If we pick Thu we may need a short follow-up for me. Either is fine but prefer Friday for my presence.

Anya R.: ok let's do Thu 9:30 PT for the dress rehearsal, then a short Friday follow-up with Maria. I'll mark calendar invite with 'dry-run' + 'follow-up' slots.

Derek H.: putting the smoke test on the bot now. command I'll use:
```
python bench/run_smoke.py --model redwood-xl-8q --requests 1000 --kv_cache=true --seed=42
```
Posting results to drive after.

BenchBot: [benchbot] scheduled job "smoke_kv_1k_1823456789" for 2026-03-18T18:00:00Z. Logs will be deposited to s3://redwood-bench/logs/1823456789/smoke_kv_1k_1823456789.log. Will notify thread when finished.

Kevin L.: For the agenda, please include: 1) quick perf readout (5m), 2) latency vs cost dashboard walkthrough (10m), 3) quantization and memory/caching effects (10m), 4) canary results and rollback plan (10m), 5) action items + owners (5m).

Anya R.: agreed. I'll add that agenda to the invite and attach the pre-read checklist. Pre-read checklist (short):
- raw logs (s3 link)
- dashboard snapshot (latency/cost)
- canary config + seed
- quick perf notes (quantization, KV cache behavior)

Derek H.: tagging owners: @Kevin L. (dashboard & heatmap), @Derek H. (canary + logs), @Maria S. (post-rollout QA checklist).

Maria S.: noted. will draft the QA checklist and share by Wed EOD.

Anya R.: Perfect — I'll send the invite for Thu 9:30 PT, attach links, and leave a follow-up tentatively Fri 11am PT. If anyone needs the calendar moved speak now. :thumbsup:

Kevin L.: :thumbsup: Also will drop a short CSV with per-bucket p95/p99 so folks can quickly check regressions.

BenchBot: [benchbot] "smoke_kv_1k_1823456789" completed. Summary: 1000 requests, avg lat 72ms, p95 210ms, p99 480ms. Uploaded full log to s3://redwood-bench/logs/1823456789/smoke_kv_1k_1823456789.log and metrics.json to the same folder.

Anya R.: awesome, thanks. I'll pull the smoke results into the pre-read and flag any anomalies. See you all Thu.
